# Semantic Scholar

> AI-powered academic research discovery platform providing intelligent paper search, citations, and developer APIs for scholarly data.

Semantic Scholar, developed by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2), is a comprehensive research tool that combines advanced natural language processing with access to millions of academic papers. The platform offers both a user-friendly interface for researchers and a powerful REST API for developers to build applications on top of scholarly data.

## Core Products

- [Semantic Scholar | AI-Powered Research Tool](https://www.semanticscholar.org): Homepage for Semantic Scholar, AI-powered research discovery platform
- [Semantic Scholar | Product](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product): Main product page featuring search, citations, and AI recommendations
- [Semantic Scholar | Semantic Reader](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/semantic-reader): AI-powered augmented scientific reading application from Semantic Scholar
- [Scholar's Hub | Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/scholars-hub): Scholar's Hub for trending papers and research discovery curation

## API Reference & Developer Tools

- [Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API | Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api): Overview of Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API for developers
- [Tutorial | Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api%2Ftutorial): Getting started guide for Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
- [Gallery | Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API](https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api%2Fgallery): Gallery of API use cases and developer projects using Semantic Scholar
- [Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API | Semantic Scholar](http://api.semanticscholar.org/corpus/legal): API legal and corpus documentation for Academic Graph
